title: BW-MED-v1 (v2.2)
description: Messaging Entity Descriptor. Carries MLS capabilities, KeyPackage discovery URL, and the entity's identity credential (x509 chain or UID QEAA). v1.2 adds the optional mls.scopes_supported capability flag (confidentiality scopes, spec §8.3a).

protocols.description: Supported messaging profiles. MUST include SM-MLS-1.0.

delivery_service.description: The base URL of the RDP's Delivery Service. This was `msp`, a bare URI naming a second provider; SBM-ADR-0015 withdraws that provider, and the Delivery Service is a function the RDP is responsible for.

ds_url.description: MLS Delivery Service endpoint for message submission.

keypackage_url.description: URL from which MLS KeyPackages for the entity's devices can be retrieved.

rdp.description: The entity's Registered Delivery Provider: its discovery and evidence surfaces, and the Delivery Service it operates. The MLS routing and KeyPackage endpoints moved here from `mls` with SBM-ADR-0015 — they are the RDP's endpoints, and `mls` describes the group's cryptographic parameters rather than who serves them.

mls.description: MLS-specific discovery data: cipher suites, KeyPackage retrieval URL, and Delivery Service endpoint.

cipher_suites.description: Supported MLS cipher suite identifiers. MUST include the baseline suite.

scopes_supported.description: Capability flag (v2.1): true ⇒ this entity supports confidentiality scopes (one MLS group per (entity pair, scope); spec §8.3a). Absent or false ⇒ default-scope only.

identity_credential.description: Entity identity credential. Either an x509 certificate chain rooted in an EU Trusted List, or a reference to a UID QEAA.

x509_chain.description: PEM-encoded certificate chain (entity QSealC + intermediates up to a Trusted List root).

qeaa_ref.description: Reference to the UID QEAA: either a status URL or the full SD-JWT-VC string.

wia_ref.description: Optional reference to the Wallet Instance Attestation (ARF).
